_comment: Patches on Yahoo PLAYERLIST rows that are wrong UPSTREAM. Applied by scripts/fetch_playerlist.py after parsing and before writing, so they survive every refetch; scripts/check_playerlist.py lists the live ones and FAILS on any past review_by, or whose Yahoo row no longer matches 'replaces' (upstream may be fixed). Keyed by Yahoo player id. 'set' may name projectedFPPG (a number) and player_proj_GP (a number, or "team": the most games remaining Yahoo projects for any teammate in the same fetch). Total FP is derived, FPPG x GP. See modules/projection_overrides.py.

_retired.reason: Yahoo's rest-of-season view gave Mobley 0 GP and 0.00 FP in the 11-16 nightly fetch while he was tagged Q (O->Q on 11-15), the 10-26 Boozer/Acuff pattern. check_playerlist refused both 11-16 nightly attempts (below 5.0 FPPG), so the Monday window run never happened. His absence is the tags' and injury entries' job, not the projection's.
_retired.source: 11-15 PLAYERLIST (Sun 8:30 AM hub): projectedFPPG 37.4; 11-16 nightly fetch: 0 GP, 0.0 FP
_retired.reviewed: 2026-11-18 (Nick): Yahoo still projects him at 0; he is a free agent outside the 175-player pool, so the override applies only if he is rostered or returns to the pool. Kept; next review 12-07.
_retired.retired_why: Yahoo fixed it upstream: the 11-24 7:13 AM forced nightly's fetch had Mobley back in the 175-player pool at GP 60.4, FP 2,203.05 (36.5 FPPG), and check_playerlist refused the run because his row no longer matched 'replaces' -- the check working as designed. Removed (reviewer, with Nick's 5f deploy).
